evidenceBoundary: Automated release checks passed for this source-limited internal demo. They do not replace the open rendered-glyph, assistive-technology, perceptual, product-evidence, privacy, or public-conformance gates.

artifactBuild.releaseCommitCapture: The publication workflow records GITHUB_SHA after commit; this pre-publication record binds exact append-only artifacts without self-referencing a future commit.

scope: release identity, normative master parity, approval receipts, and evidence boundary
seven exact shared atmosphere gradients, fifteen gradient-stop-only values, eighteen-record inventory, theme defaults, motif alias, and no-blanket-scrim rule
immutable Color Set baseline, append-only UI artifact, latest alias reproduction, byte counts, and SHA-256 records
single-weight JetBrains Mono 400 and IBM Plex Sans Thai 400 technical pair, capsule actions, favicon/SEO/noindex boundaries, and Complete Color Atlas coverage

immutable UI artifact differs from latest only by the declared build-channel marker
immutable Color Set baseline and UI artifact match their append-only registry records
existing immutable targets fail closed on unexpected bytes
caption labels never overlap the color strips at narrow viewports
5/7/9 cells remain equal-width and strips retain their minimum width

localHttpSmoke.scope: Hosted source, versioned records, normative download, mutable and immutable standalones, color registry, approved identity images, team image, and representative governed font files.

browserQA.scope: 36 rendered geometry cases across English/Thai, Light/Dark, seven required widths, and representative 200% text scale.
browserQA.limitation: The in-app browser blocks direct navigation to a newly generated file:// target. Final visual and console review is therefore performed against the deployed HTTPS artifact before publication is declared complete.
